name: Jupyter
description: Jupyter notebook cells on the canvas: Python code cells linked into pipelines on a real kernel, run by you or by linked terminals (orkestri cell). Comes with its own Python 3.12.16 and ipykernel 7.4.0 inside the package (python-build-standalone, pinned): installing it only unpacks them, no Python needed on the computer, nothing system-wide. Not made or endorsed by Project Jupyter.
